passage.text: When the arrow of intentionality loses energy and falls, the therapists recover it and give it new momentum. When the arrow falls, is recovered, and is re-launched in this way, the emotive intensity of the moment increases. Moments of full contact are always unpredictable: we do not know when they will occur, or in which minute or second of contacting. They do not occur by chance, however. It is the therapists who help bring about these moments by supporting the intentionality of the clients as it unfolds second by second and encounters the therapists' own intentionality.
